overview.zh: S3 使用独立 FreeRTOS 任务做编码器采集、触觉采集和 CAN 发送。编码器数据经长度 1 的覆盖队列传递，触觉摘要另走 CAN 与串口；名义周期、核与优先级见各任务节点。
overview.en: S3 uses separate FreeRTOS tasks for encoder acquisition, tactile acquisition, and CAN transmission. Encoder samples pass through a one-item overwrite queue; tactile summaries also use CAN and serial. Each task node lists nominal period, core, and priority.

zh.plain: S3 固件把采集任务与通信任务分开：编码器任务快速采样并覆盖长度 1 的队列，CAN 任务发送编码器帧，触觉任务独立扫描后发送摘要/串口数据。
zh.condition: 由 startSystemTasks 创建；ENABLE_TACTILE_TASK 控制触觉任务是否启动。
zh.effect: 任务配置定义周期、优先级、核和栈；共享队列只保存最近一份 EncoderData，避免 CAN 发送变慢时堆积旧样本。
zh.failure: 队列创建失败进入 fatal 延迟循环；触觉关闭时不会启动 Task_Tactile。
zh.recovery: 检查启动日志、队列创建和 Config.h 任务开关；CAN 故障看 CanTask 计数与 bus recover。
zh.unknown: 静态配置不提供实机 CPU 负载、调度抖动或传感器实际在线证明。
zh.difference: 队列覆盖策略是“保留最新采样”，不是逐样本可靠历史记录。
zh.change: 基线未标记 S3 任务装配为本次变更。

en.plain: S3 firmware separates acquisition and communication tasks: the encoder task samples quickly and overwrites a one-item queue, the CAN task sends encoder frames, and the tactile task scans independently before sending summaries/serial data.
en.condition: Tasks are created by startSystemTasks; ENABLE_TACTILE_TASK controls whether the tactile task starts.
en.effect: Task configuration defines period, priority, core, and stack. The shared queue stores only the latest EncoderData so slow CAN transmission does not accumulate stale samples.
en.failure: Queue creation failure enters a fatal delay loop; disabling tactile support means Task_Tactile is not started.
en.recovery: Check startup logs, queue creation, and Config.h task switches; use CanTask counters and bus-recovery logs for CAN faults.
en.unknown: Static configuration does not prove runtime CPU load, scheduling jitter, or sensor availability.
en.difference: The queue uses latest-sample overwrite semantics, not a lossless history.
en.change: The baseline does not mark S3 task assembly as changed.

zh.plain: Task_Encoders 每 2 ms 读取 21 路 AS5047P 原始角度和 errorFlags；无效通道写成 0xFFFF，再覆盖写入 encoder queue。
zh.condition: 由 startSystemTasks 固定到 Core 1，优先级 TASK_ENC_PRIO=10；循环按 kEncoderTaskPeriodMs=2 延迟到下个周期。
zh.effect: 每轮复制 EncoderData 到 localData，并调用 xQueueOverwrite；队列容量为 1，CAN 任务总是取到最近一次可用采样。
zh.failure: 队列句柄为空时任务不会提交数据，并周期性输出 fatal 日志；errorFlags 通道以 0xFFFF sentinel 表示无效。
zh.recovery: 确认 xQueueEncoderData 已创建，查看 encoder error flags 和队列消费者状态。
zh.unknown: 源码给出名义 2 ms 周期；SPI 等待和调度可能影响实测周期。
zh.difference: 这是采集生产者；它不直接发送 CAN，Task_CanBus 负责消费队列。
zh.change: 基线未标记该任务为本次变更。

en.plain: Task_Encoders reads 21 AS5047P raw angles and errorFlags every 2 ms. It writes 0xFFFF for invalid channels, then overwrites the encoder queue with the newest sample.
en.condition: startSystemTasks pins it to Core 1 at TASK_ENC_PRIO=10; the loop delays until the next kEncoderTaskPeriodMs=2 tick.
en.effect: Each loop copies EncoderData into localData and calls xQueueOverwrite. The queue has capacity one, so the CAN task receives the latest available sample.
en.failure: A null queue handle prevents submission and triggers a periodic fatal log; channels with errorFlags use the 0xFFFF invalid sentinel.
en.recovery: Confirm xQueueEncoderData was created and inspect encoder error flags and the queue consumer.
en.unknown: The source specifies a nominal 2 ms period; SPI waits and scheduling can change measured timing.
en.difference: This is the acquisition producer; it does not send CAN directly. Task_CanBus consumes the queue.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this task as changed.

zh.plain: Task_Tactile 每约 33 ms 更新触觉传感器，读取采集数据和诊断位图；默认把摘要分别送到 CAN relay 和 S3 串口。
zh.condition: 由 startSystemTasks 在 ENABLE_TACTILE_TASK 开启时创建于 Core 0，优先级 TASK_TAC_PRIO=5，栈 8192。
zh.effect: 每轮 tactile.update/getData/getDiagnostics；CAN relay 开启时发送 summary，始终发送 Serial summary，并按开关/降采样配置发送 full dump 和诊断。
zh.failure: full CAN dump 默认受 ENABLE_TACTILE_CAN_FULL_DUMP 控制；传感器读失败会体现在 summaryOkMask/diagnostics，而非伪装有效值。
zh.recovery: 查看 enable 开关、诊断位图、序列号及 serial/CAN 接收端是否在线。
zh.unknown: 名义周期约 33 ms；阻塞式传感器读取可能影响实际节拍，需实机确认。
zh.difference: 触觉摘要存在 CAN 与串口路径；全量数据配置可能带来显著带宽负载。
zh.change: 基线未标记该任务为本次变更。

en.plain: Task_Tactile updates tactile sensors about every 33 ms and reads data plus diagnostic masks; it sends summaries through CAN relay and the S3 serial link.
en.condition: When ENABLE_TACTILE_TASK is on, startSystemTasks creates it on Core 0 at TASK_TAC_PRIO=5 with an 8192-byte stack.
en.effect: Each loop calls tactile.update/getData/getDiagnostics. With CAN relay enabled it sends a summary, always sends a serial summary, and emits full dump/diagnostics according to switches and decimation.
en.failure: Full CAN dump is gated by ENABLE_TACTILE_CAN_FULL_DUMP; failed sensor reads appear in summaryOkMask/diagnostics rather than valid-looking data.
en.recovery: Inspect enable switches, diagnostic masks, sequence numbers, and whether serial/CAN receivers are online.
en.unknown: The nominal period is about 33 ms; blocking sensor reads can affect actual cadence and require hardware measurement.
en.difference: Tactile summaries have CAN and serial paths; enabling full data can consume substantial bandwidth.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this task as changed.

zh.plain: Task_CanBus 每 4 ms 维护 TWAI 总线并尝试从长度 1 的 encoder queue 取最新样本，随后发送一批编码器 CAN 帧。
zh.condition: 由 startSystemTasks 创建在 Core 0、优先级 TASK_CAN_PRIO=5、栈 4096；主循环名义周期 kCanTaskPeriodMs=4。
zh.effect: 总线正常时消费队列并统计成功/失败帧；每五批最多检查一次传感器错误并按需上报。bus-off/STOPPED 时执行 maintain 恢复路径。
zh.failure: 总线未就绪时不发送队列数据并延迟 50 ms；队列为空时没有新编码器帧可发。
zh.recovery: 检查 TWAI bus recovery 计数、队列接收计数与 tx 成功/失败计数，并核对 S3-P4 CAN 接线和配置。
zh.unknown: 名义 4 ms 循环和 50 ms 错误延迟不保证 bus 恢复成功或 P4 收到帧。
zh.difference: 它是 CAN 发送消费者；数据来源是 Task_Encoders 覆盖写队列。
zh.change: 基线未标记该任务为本次变更。

en.plain: Task_CanBus maintains the TWAI bus every 4 ms and tries to take the newest encoder sample from the one-item queue before sending a batch of encoder CAN frames.
en.condition: startSystemTasks creates it on Core 0 at TASK_CAN_PRIO=5 with a 4096-byte stack; the main loop has nominal period kCanTaskPeriodMs=4.
en.effect: When the bus is healthy it consumes the queue and counts successful/failed frames; every fifth batch it checks sensor errors and reports them when needed. maintain handles bus-off/STOPPED recovery.
en.failure: When the bus is unavailable it does not send queued data and delays 50 ms; an empty queue means there is no new encoder sample to send.
en.recovery: Inspect bus-recovery, queue-receive, and TX success/failure counters; verify S3–P4 CAN wiring and configuration.
en.unknown: A nominal 4 ms loop and 50 ms error delay do not guarantee bus recovery or P4 reception.
en.difference: This is the CAN consumer; its samples come from the overwrite queue written by Task_Encoders.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this task as changed.

zh.plain: TWAI 是 S3 与 P4 之间的 CAN 驱动/总线端点；Task_CanBus 用它传编码器批次，触觉任务可选传触觉摘要。
zh.condition: 启用对应 CAN 任务与 relay 开关，并确保总线驱动完成初始化。
zh.effect: 总线端点提供 maintain、sendEncoderData、sendTactileSummary 等收发操作。
zh.failure: bus-off 或发送失败会导致帧丢失；Task_CanBus 的恢复状态可能暂时不收发。
zh.recovery: 检查 TWAI 错误与恢复计数、节点配置和物理总线。
zh.unknown: 本源码图不证明终端电阻、布线或现场仲裁状态。
zh.difference: 编码器通过队列送往 CAN；触觉摘要是独立数据类别。
zh.change: 基线未标记该总线节点为本次变更。

en.plain: TWAI is the S3–P4 CAN driver/bus endpoint. Task_CanBus uses it for encoder batches, and the tactile task can optionally send tactile summaries.
en.condition: The corresponding CAN task and relay switch must be enabled and the driver initialized.
en.effect: The endpoint provides operations such as maintain, sendEncoderData, and sendTactileSummary.
en.failure: Bus-off or send failures can drop frames; Task_CanBus may temporarily stop traffic during recovery.
en.recovery: Inspect TWAI error/recovery counters, node configuration, and the physical bus.
en.unknown: This source view does not prove termination, wiring, or live arbitration health.
en.difference: Encoder traffic arrives through the queue; tactile summaries are a separate data class.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this bus node as changed.

zh.plain: S3 的串口触觉路径把摘要、全量触觉数据和诊断包发送给桌面端；它与 CAN relay 并存。
zh.condition: Task_Tactile 每轮调用串口发送函数；全量帧由 ENABLE_TACTILE_CAN_FULL_DUMP 等配置控制。
zh.effect: 串口帧使用 FE/FF 边界和触觉 packet type；摘要携带序列号与成功位图，全量包携带传感器数据。
zh.failure: 串口未连接、帧损坏或桌面端解析不匹配时，触觉显示无法刷新；打开过多 full dump 也会占用带宽。
zh.recovery: 检查 tactile serial 端口、包类型、序列号和诊断 CRC；需要时关闭全量 dump。
zh.unknown: 静态源码未证明当前接收端、带宽和帧周期。
zh.difference: 触觉串口可绕开 CAN 转发摘要，CAN 和串口并非同一条物理链路。
zh.change: 基线未标记该串口路径为本次变更。

en.plain: The S3 tactile serial path sends summaries, full tactile data, and diagnostic packets to the desktop alongside the CAN relay.
en.condition: Task_Tactile calls serial send functions each cycle; full-frame behavior is controlled by configuration such as ENABLE_TACTILE_CAN_FULL_DUMP.
en.effect: Serial frames use FE/FF boundaries and tactile packet types. Summaries carry sequence and success masks; full packets carry sensor data.
en.failure: An offline serial link, corrupt frame, or desktop parser mismatch prevents tactile display updates; excessive full dumps can consume bandwidth.
en.recovery: Check the tactile serial port, packet type, sequence, and diagnostic CRC; disable full dumps if needed.
en.unknown: The source does not prove the live receiver, bandwidth, or frame cadence.
en.difference: Tactile serial can deliver summaries without CAN relay; these are distinct physical paths.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this serial path as changed.
